changes: Games now have more browser headroom for sound, LCD effects and the interface: six representative games measured 1.49% to 2.82% faster, with a 2.17% median gain.
The speed-up only removes repeated sprite-layer work; the Game Boy's fixed speed, rendered frames and audio timing stay the same.
Super Mario Land, Link's Awakening DX, Pokémon Blue, Wario Land 3, Shantae and Pokémon Crystal all kept their previous checksums.
Audio conformance remains 49/70 and DMG picture matching remains 92.9402%, with no new timeouts.
This is a small performance patch between the v2.5 accuracy work and the larger v3.0 milestone.
